description: This file defines the ConnectionManager class for managing WebSocket connections and broadcasting messages within a FastAPI backend, including methods for connecting, disconnecting, sending personal messages, broadcasting different types of data, and tracking active connections.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Handles WebSocket connections, maintaining active connections, and broadcasting messages like analytics updates, reactions, and match updates.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the ConnectionManager with an empty list of active connections.

methods.name: connect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Accepts a new WebSocket connection and adds it to the active connections list.

methods.name: disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from the active list.

methods.name: send_personal_message(self, message: str, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific WebSocket client.

methods.name: broadcast(self, message: str)
methods.description: Sends a message to all active WebSocket clients.

methods.name: broadcast_analytics_update(self, analytics_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts analytics data to all clients.

methods.name: broadcast_reaction(self, reaction_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts reaction data (like emojis) to all clients.

methods.name: broadcast_match_update(self, match_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts match update data to all clients.

methods.name: int get_connection_count(self)
methods.description: Returns the number of active WebSocket connections.

ctags.name: broadcast_analytics_update
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast_analytics_update(self, analytics_data: Dict[str, Any]):$/

ctags.name: broadcast_match_update
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast_match_update(self, match_data: Dict[str, Any]):$/

ctags.name: broadcast_reaction
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast_reaction(self, reaction_data: Dict[str, Any]):$/

ctags.name: send_personal_message
ctags.pattern: /^    async def send_personal_message(self, message: str, websocket: WebSocket):$/
